title: IntelEngine — NPC Autonomy & Faction Politics
tagline: Give Skyrim’s NPCs agency—tasks, schedules, autonomous stories, and faction politics.
description:
IntelEngine gives Skyrim's NPCs the ability to act autonomously through SkyrimNet. NPCs can travel, deliver messages, fetch or escort people, schedule meetings and tasks, spread gossip, pursue personal storylines, and participate in an evolving faction-politics system.

Originally created by **Galanx**. **PhospheneOverdrive** currently maintains it in the official galanx repositories (IntelEngine-GamePlugin and IntelEngine-NativePlugin), with Galanx's go-ahead.

Release **3.7** is a big Director and dashboard update: an experimental **Generate** button fills Director forms for you, Director requests now confirm or explain a refusal on screen, finished NPC stories and social scenes appear in SkyrimNet's History, and the dashboard can run on **Magelight UI** (recommended; PrismaUI still works as a fallback). It also fixes duplicate arrivals, mod-added NPC IDs and faction-leader matching.

⚠️ **Upgrading from a pre-3.6 save? Convert it before loading with 3.7.x.** Saves already on 3.6.x and fresh games don't need conversion. See the FAQ included in the download for instructions. Windows Defender may flag the bundled converter as a false positive; it is being reported to Microsoft.

3.7.0 tested on **Skyrim SE/AE 1.6.1170**. 1.7.104 and **VR 1.4.15 should work** (1.7.104 tested on 3.6; VR partly tested on 3.6). Skyrim 1.5.97 is untested. Use the matching versions of **SKSE and Address Library**.

**Have issues?** Report them on the IntelEngine-GamePlugin GitHub issues page.

**Requires SkyrimNet Beta 27 or newer. Not compatible with Beta 26 or earlier.** Optional: Magelight UI 1.7.1+ for the dashboard.
author: phospheneoverdrive
changelog:
### Director
- New **Generate** button on Story, NPC Social, Political and Action forms fills in a draft from nearby NPCs and factions. **Experimental:** quality depends on the model in SkyrimNet's default slot; small models (e.g. 4B) fill fields unreliably, so review before dispatching. Stop and Clear buttons too.
- Director requests now show an on-screen notice when accepted and the reason when refused; busy NPCs ask before replacing their task.
- Drafts are remembered across reloads; NPC and faction pickers are searchable; required fields are marked and block Dispatch until filled.
- Action Execution: optional reason, works on non-unique NPCs (guards, city folk), and Cancel/Change Speed act straight away.

### Dashboard
- Optional **Magelight UI** host (1.7.1+, recommended): Esc closes the menu. PrismaUI stays as a fallback.
- Tasks tab shows each task's origin, in-game time and reason, plus the NPC's current package. Actions are grouped by category.
- Politics shows in-game dates and faction leaders.
- Finished Story and Social outcomes are recorded in SkyrimNet's History.

### Fixes
- No more duplicate arrivals or stale story callbacks repeating outcomes.
- Mod-added NPCs (high form IDs) are no longer mixed up in dashboard actions.
- Better exact NPC and faction-leader matching; same-faction political pairs are rejected.
- Task history now says "tried to" when a task didn't succeed.
- Localized place names are kept intact in travel prompts.

This release updates `IntelEngine.dll` and scripts that must match it; install the whole package over the previous version.

**Antivirus note:** Microsoft Defender may flag the bundled save converter `LegacyCacheMigration.exe` as a false positive. It is only needed to upgrade 3.5.x saves.

Full changelog: https://github.com/galanx/IntelEngine-GamePlugin/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#370--2026-11-03
Download: https://github.com/galanx/IntelEngine-GamePlugin/releases/tag/v3.7.0
